candidates.title: What Matters for Aggressive Decoding-Time KV Eviction? Temporal Aggregation and Ranking Preservation
candidates.reason: aggressive KV cache evictionでtoken scorerだけでなくdecode-step間のtemporal aggregationを系統評価し、EMA-based InertiaKV-Lazyでfull-refresh比1.34–1.46x decode throughputを報告する。KV memory管理の新着かつ実測評価付き研究。

candidates.title: Memory Compression for High-Fanout Agent Sandboxes
candidates.reason: high-fanout AI-agent sandboxのtemplate-relative/cross-sandbox memory redundancyを圧縮し、LLM待機時間にcompressionを寄せrestore prefetchでoverheadを抑えるOS-level memory system。sandbox-owned memory最大8.7x削減を報告し、agentic servingの階層メモリ隣接として有用。

candidates.title: Speculative Macro Commit for Faster Tool-Using Agents
candidates.reason: tool-using agentのserial action-observation latencyを、small drafterによるisolated snapshot上のmulti-step speculative executionとmacro commitで短縮するruntime方式。sequential比18.59%/44.9%のwall-clock短縮を報告し、agentic inference schedulingの隣接重要候補。
